# Configuration keys

Every key of `config.yaml` with its type and built-in value. A key you leave out keeps following the built-in value, also when a later release changes it.

Settings live in `config.yaml` in the profile home. `indus config show` prints the file, `indus config set <key> <value>` changes one key. Keys are written here as dotted paths: `agent.max_turns` is `max_turns` inside the `agent:` section.

## model

The chat model and its endpoint.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | str or ModelSection |  | the chat model and its endpoint |
| `model.default` | str | `""` | model id used when nothing else picks one |
| `model.provider` | str | `""` | provider name; empty means detect from keys |
| `model.base_url` | str | `""` | custom endpoint URL (OpenAI-compatible) |
| `model.api_mode` | str | `""` | wire format override for the endpoint |
| `model.context_length` | int or null | `null` | context window override in tokens |

## providers

Named custom providers.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `providers` | dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | `{}` | named custom providers |

## fallback_providers

Routes tried in order when the main one fails: {provider, model} entries.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fallback_providers` | list[dict[str, Any]] | `[]` | routes tried in order when the main one fails: {provider, model} entries |

## fallback

Switching to the fallback chain.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fallback.min_switch_reset_s` | float | `0.0` | stay on a rate-limited main model when its limit resets sooner than this many seconds (wait instead of switching); 0 = always switch |

## agent

The turn loop.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent.max_turns` | int | `150` | model calls per turn before a summary; 0 = no cap |
| `agent.api_max_retries` | int | `3` | retries for a failed model call |
| `agent.gateway_timeout` | int | `1800` | seconds a messaging turn may run |
| `agent.restart_drain_timeout` | float | `0.0` | gateway stop: seconds running chat turns get to finish before they are interrupted (they resume after the restart) |
| `agent.restart_after_turn_timeout` | float | `1800.0` | gateway restart (SIGUSR1): longest wait for running turns to finish |
| `agent.cron_drain_timeout` | float | `30.0` | gateway stop: seconds running cron jobs get to finish (10 s of it is kept for cleanup) |
| `agent.clarify_timeout` | int | `3600` | seconds to wait for an answer to a question |
| `agent.local_stream_stale_timeout` | int | `900` | seconds a local model server may stay silent mid-stream |
| `agent.turn_liveness_s` | float | `600.0` | seconds a reply may show no activity before it is stopped (0 = off) |
| `agent.run_budget_s` | float | `0.0` | wall-clock seconds one run may take, like --run-budget (0 = off) |
| `agent.fast_mode` | 'normal' \| 'fast' \| 'auto' | `normal` | the provider's priority tier: normal, fast (always) or auto (per turn) |
| `agent.fast_window_s` | float | `60.0` | seconds each user turn asks for the priority tier in auto mode |
| `agent.reconnect_attention_after` | float | `1800.0` | seconds a messaging platform may keep failing to reconnect before the gateway flags it as needing attention (0 = never; retries go on either way) |

## terminal

Where and how commands run.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `terminal.backend` | str | `local` | where commands run: local, docker, ssh, ... |
| `terminal.cwd` | str | `.` | working directory for commands |
| `terminal.timeout` | int | `180` | seconds before a command is stopped |
| `terminal.env_passthrough` | list[str] | `[]` | extra variable names passed through to commands |
| `terminal.persistent_shell` | bool | `true` | exported variables carry over between commands (cwd always does) |

| `terminal.lifetime_s` | int | `300` | seconds an unused environment is kept before it is cleaned up |
| `terminal.degraded_mode` | 'warn' \| 'fail' | `warn` | backend unreachable: warn returns a degraded result, fail returns an error |
| `terminal.daemon_term_grace_s` | float | `2.0` | seconds a stopped command gets after SIGTERM before SIGKILL |
| `terminal.max_foreground_timeout` | int | `600` | longest foreground timeout; above it a command runs as a background job |
| `terminal.process_wait_auto_notify` | bool | `true` | two checks of a silent background job switch on a message when it ends |
| `terminal.docker_binary` | str | `""` | docker or podman client path; empty = docker, then podman on PATH |
| `terminal.docker_image` | str | `ghcr.io/indusagi/indus-agent-sandbox:stable-slim` | image the Docker sandbox runs (Indus's own sandbox image by default) |
| `terminal.docker_image_pinned` | bool | `false` | docker_image must name a digest (@sha256:...) |
| `terminal.docker_forward_env` | list[str] | `[]` | variable names passed into the container (values never on a command line) |
| `terminal.docker_env` | dict[str, str] | `{}` | extra variables set inside the container |
| `terminal.docker_volumes` | list[str] | `[]` | host:container[:options] binds (prompts come back on) |
| `terminal.docker_extra_args` | list[str] | `[]` | extra docker run arguments, added last |
| `terminal.docker_shm_size` | str | `1g` | size of /dev/shm; empty or 0 keeps Docker's own default |
| `terminal.docker_network` | bool | `true` | false runs the container offline |
| `terminal.docker_run_as_host_user` | bool | `false` | run as your uid:gid so files you share stay yours |
| `terminal.docker_snap_compat` | bool | `false` | snap-packaged Docker: run without no-new-privileges |
| `terminal.docker_mount_cwd_to_workspace` | bool | `false` | bind the host working directory at /workspace (approval prompts come back on) |
| `terminal.docker_persist_across_processes` | bool | `true` | reuse the labelled container a previous run left |
| `terminal.docker_shared_key` | str | `""` | profiles with the same key share one container |
| `terminal.docker_orphan_reaper` | bool | `true` | remove old Indus containers of this profile at start |
| `terminal.container_cpu` | float | `1.0` | CPUs for a sandbox container |
| `terminal.container_memory_mb` | int | `5120` | memory cap of a sandbox, in MB |
| `terminal.container_disk_mb` | int | `51200` | disk cap of a sandbox in MB (where the host supports it) |
| `terminal.container_persistent` | bool | `true` | keep /root and /workspace between runs; false = a fresh sandbox per session |
| `terminal.singularity_image` | str | `""` | singularity backend: image (.sif path or docker://…); empty = docker_image |
| `terminal.scratch_dir` | str | `""` | singularity backend: SIF cache and overlays (empty: under the profile home) |
| `terminal.disk_warning_gb` | float | `500.0` | singularity backend: warn once when scratch use passes this |
| `terminal.modal_mode` | str | `auto` | modal backend: auto or direct (both use your own Modal token pair) |
| `terminal.modal_image` | str | `""` | modal backend: image (or im- id); empty = terminal.docker_image |
| `terminal.daytona_image` | str | `""` | daytona backend: image; empty = terminal.docker_image |
| `terminal.vercel_runtime` | '' \| 'node24' \| 'node22' \| 'python3.13' | `""` | vercel_sandbox backend: runtime in place of the default image |
| `terminal.sync_back_max_bytes` | int | `2147483648` | largest sandbox archive brought back at cleanup (bytes) |
| `terminal.ssh_host` | str | `""` | ssh backend: host to run commands on |
| `terminal.ssh_user` | str | `""` | ssh backend: login user; empty = ssh's default |
| `terminal.ssh_port` | int | `22` | ssh backend: port |
| `terminal.ssh_key` | str | `""` | ssh backend: identity file; empty = agent/keys |
| `terminal.ssh_persistent_shell` | bool | `true` | ssh backend: exported variables carry over between commands |
| `terminal.credential_files` | list[str] | `[]` | host files copied into sandboxes (mounted read-only, pushed upload-only) |
| `terminal.background_memory_max` | str or int | `1G` | memory cap of a local background process on Linux with systemd (64M..4G, a bare number is MiB; off disables) |

## egress

The egress proxy for Docker sandboxes.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `egress.enabled` | bool | `false` | route Docker sandboxes through the host's egress proxy |
| `egress.enforce` | bool | `true` | refuse a sandbox whose settings would bypass the proxy (off: they win) |
| `egress.port` | int | `47900` | the proxy's port (0 = any) |
| `egress.bind` | str | `auto` | the proxy's listen address; auto = the Docker bridge on Linux, else loopback |
| `egress.hosts` | list[str] | `[]` | extra hosts whose TLS the proxy opens (nothing injected unless a rule says) |
| `egress.rules` | list[dict[str, Any]] | `[]` | injection rules: {host, secret, header} (the secret's value never leaves the host) |
| `egress.block_other_hosts` | bool | `false` | refuse hosts that are not on the egress list |

## approvals

Asking before risky commands.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `approvals.mode` | 'manual' \| 'smart' \| 'off' | `manual` | manual asks before risky commands; smart pre-judges; off never asks |
| `approvals.timeout` | int | `300` | seconds to wait for an approval answer |
| `approvals.deny` | list[str] | `[]` | command patterns that are always refused |

| `approvals.single_query_mode` | 'deny' \| 'approve' | `deny` | risky commands in one-shot runs (indus -q): deny or approve |
| `approvals.unattended_mode` | 'deny' \| 'approve' | `deny` | risky commands where nobody can answer (API, webhooks): deny or approve |
| `approvals.denial_breaker_threshold` | int | `3` | smart mode: refusals in a row before the model is told to stop (0 = off) |
| `approvals.smart_policy` | str | `""` | smart mode: extra rules for the judge, in plain words |
| `approvals.mcp_reload_confirm` | bool | `true` | ask before /reload-mcp (it changes the tools, so the prompt cache misses) |
| `approvals.destructive_slash_confirm` | bool | `false` | ask before /rollback, /undo, /new and other commands that drop work (chat and messaging) |

## gateway

The messaging gateway.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway.message_timestamps.enabled` | bool | `false` | tell the model when each message was sent (never shown) |
| `gateway.trust_env` | bool | `true` | platform connections use the HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY environment |
| `gateway.group_sessions_per_user` | bool | `true` | each person in a group chat gets their own conversation |
| `gateway.thread_sessions_per_user` | bool | `false` | each person in a thread gets their own conversation |
| `gateway.unauthorized_dm_behavior` | 'pair' \| 'ignore' \| 'decline' | `pair` | a direct message from someone not allowed: pair (send a pairing code), ignore, or decline (one short refusal a day) |
| `gateway.bot_loop_guard.enabled` | bool | `true` | count bot-authored messages per chat |
| `gateway.bot_loop_guard.max_messages` | int | `20` | bot-authored messages allowed in one window |
| `gateway.bot_loop_guard.window_seconds` | float | `300.0` | length of the window |
| `gateway.bot_loop_guard.cooldown_seconds` | float | `600.0` | how long a tripped chat ignores bot messages |
| `gateway.max_concurrent_sessions` | int or null | `null` | most conversations running at once; unset = no cap |
| `gateway.media_strict` | bool | `false` | send files only from the gateway caches and media_allow_dirs |
| `gateway.media_allow_dirs` | list[str] | `[]` | extra folders (absolute or ~/) whose files replies may send |
| `gateway.media_trust_recent` | bool | `false` | also send files written in the last media_trust_recent_seconds outside the trusted folders (off: a file's age can be faked with touch) |
| `gateway.media_trust_recent_seconds` | float | `600.0` | how recent a file must be for media_trust_recent |
| `gateway.connect_timeout_seconds` | float | `30.0` | seconds a platform may take to connect at startup |
| `gateway.systemd_watchdog_seconds` | float | `0.0` | systemd watchdog interval; 0 turns the pings off |
| `gateway.idle_exit_seconds` | float | `600.0` | a gateway a client started on its own exits after this many seconds with no client and no work; 0 keeps it running |
| `gateway.delivery_ledger` | bool | `true` | record each chat reply before sending it, so a crash or restart cannot lose it (recovered replies are labelled) |
| `gateway.stt_enabled` | bool | `true` | transcribe voice messages people send (off: the agent gets the file path) |
| `gateway.api_server.enabled` | bool | `false` | serve the HTTP API from the gateway |
| `gateway.api_server.host` | str | `127.0.0.1` | address to bind (loopback by default) |
| `gateway.api_server.port` | int | `8642` | port to bind; 0 = any free one |
| `gateway.api_server.cors_origins` | list[str] | `[]` | browser origins allowed to call the API (none by default) |
| `gateway.api_server.max_concurrent_runs` | int | `10` | API turns running at once; more get 429; 0 = no cap |
| `gateway.api_server.model_name` | str | `indus-agent` | the model id /v1/models shows to clients |
| `gateway.api_server.idle_close_seconds` | float | `900.0` | close an API session after this long with nothing to do |
| `gateway.webhook.enabled` | bool | `false` | receive webhooks in the gateway |
| `gateway.webhook.host` | str | `127.0.0.1` | address to bind (loopback by default) |
| `gateway.webhook.port` | int | `8644` | port to bind; 0 = any free one |
| `gateway.webhook.rate_limit` | int | `30` | requests per minute per route |
| `gateway.webhook.max_body_bytes` | int | `1048576` | largest request body accepted, in bytes |
| `gateway.webhook.routes` | dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | `{}` | webhook routes by name (secret names a stored secret, never its value) |
| `gateway.multiplex_profiles` | bool | `false` | one gateway process serves every profile under this root (off: one gateway per profile) |
| `gateway.profile_routes` | list[dict[str, Any]] | `[]` | with multiplex_profiles: hand messages a bot receives to another profile ({name, platform, profile, bot, guild, chat, thread, user, enabled}; most specific wins) |
| `gateway.relay.url` | str | `""` | the connector's base URL (https://…); empty: no relay |
| `gateway.relay.gateway_id` | str | `""` | this gateway's id at the connector |
| `gateway.relay.connect_timeout_seconds` | float | `30.0` | seconds to dial and finish the signed handshake |
| `gateway.relay.request_timeout_seconds` | float | `30.0` | seconds to wait for the answer to one operation |

## dashboard

The web dashboard (indus dashboard).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dashboard.public_url` | str | `""` | the full address people reach the dashboard at behind a proxy; a non-loopback host turns sign-in on |
| `dashboard.trusted_proxies` | list[str] | `[]` | proxy addresses or bounded networks whose X-Forwarded-* headers are believed (loopback always is; '*' and /0 are refused) |
| `dashboard.basic_auth.username` | str | `""` | sign-in name; empty turns the provider off |
| `dashboard.basic_auth.password_hash` | str | `""` | argon2id hash of the password (`indus dashboard` on a terminal writes it); never the password itself — INDUS_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD in the environment overrides it |
| `dashboard.oidc.issuer` | str | `""` | issuer URL (https; http only on loopback) |
| `dashboard.oidc.client_id` | str | `""` | public client id (PKCE, no client secret) |
| `dashboard.oidc.scopes` | str | `openid profile email` | scopes asked for at sign-in |
| `dashboard.oidc.id_token_leeway` | float | `60.0` | seconds of clock skew allowed on ID token times; 0 = strict, an invalid value counts as 0 |
| `dashboard.theme` | 'system' \| 'light' \| 'dark' | `system` | dashboard colours: system, light or dark |
| `dashboard.show_token_analytics` | bool | `false` | show the token and cost analytics page |

## acp

The editor agent (indus acp).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acp.allow_local_fallback` | bool | `false` | with no gateway daemon running, run editor sessions in the `indus acp` process instead of refusing them (D-16.83) |

## updates

Updating this install (indus update).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `updates.check` | bool | `true` | show passive update notices (indus --version); explicit `indus update --check` always works |
| `updates.pre_update_backup` | 'quick' \| 'full' \| 'off' | `quick` | what `indus update` saves first: quick, full or off |
| `updates.backup_keep` | int | `5` | full pre-update backups kept in the backup folder |
| `updates.installs` | dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | `{}` | per install id (`indus update --install-id`): channel (stable, canary or main) and extras |

## a2a

A2A peer agents, inbound and outbound.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `a2a.host` | str | `127.0.0.1` | address to serve on (loopback by default) |
| `a2a.port` | int | `9900` | port to serve on |
| `a2a.public` | bool | `false` | required to serve on a non-loopback address |
| `a2a.public_url` | str | `""` | the URL peers reach this agent at (for the agent card) |
| `a2a.agent_name` | str | `Indus Agent` | name on the agent card |
| `a2a.description` | str | `An Indus agent reachable over A2A.` | description on the agent card |
| `a2a.inbound_peers` | list[str] | `[]` | peers allowed to send tasks; none: every call is refused |
| `a2a.reply_timeout_seconds` | float | `300.0` | seconds a peer's call waits for the agent's reply |
| `a2a.max_turns_per_context` | int | `5` | messages one peer conversation may send before it is refused |
| `a2a.peers` | dict[str, A2APeerSection] |  | peer agents the a2a_call tool may call, by name |
| `a2a.peers.url` | str | `null` | the peer's A2A JSON-RPC endpoint URL |
| `a2a.peers.trusted` | bool | `null` | allow a private, loopback or link-local address for this peer |
| `a2a.peers.timeout_seconds` | float | `null` | seconds to wait for an answer |

## lsp

Language-server checks of edits (indus lsp).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lsp.enabled` | bool | `true` | check edits with a language server when one is installed (nothing is ever installed for you; see `indus lsp status`) |
| `lsp.wait_timeout` | float | `5.0` | seconds to wait for a server's verdict on an edit |
| `lsp.idle_timeout` | float | `600.0` | seconds an unused server keeps running (values under 30 count as 30; 0 = never stop idle servers) |
| `lsp.broken_retry_s` | float | `0.0` | seconds before a server that failed to start is tried again (0 = only after `indus lsp restart`) |
| `lsp.trusted_workspaces` | list[str] | `[]` | folders where servers that run project code (rust-analyzer, gopls, ...) may start, besides the session's own work tree |
| `lsp.servers` | dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | `{}` | per-server overrides or new servers: command, extensions, root_markers, language_id, env, initialization_options, disabled |

## verify

Workspace checks (indus verify).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `verify.on_stop` | bool | `false` | after code edits, run the workspace's build and test before the agent's answer is final, and send it back to work when they fail |
| `verify.phase_timeout` | float | `600.0` | seconds each bootstrap/build/test command may run |
| `verify.ready_timeout` | float | `60.0` | seconds a started service gets to answer on 127.0.0.1 |
| `verify.max_stop_attempts` | int | `2` | times per turn verify-on-stop may send the agent back |
| `verify.max_hook_nudges` | int | `3` | times per turn a pre_verify plugin hook may send it back |

Helper programs (indus pm).
